sheet.div: Weighted vote: each attendee casts their own votes using the vote type; the system stores individual voting lines (roll-call).
Manual vote (simple count): enter final totals for yes, no, abstention, and blank only. The system does not record how each attendee voted; no per-attendee vote lines are created for this item.
Manual vote (multi-option): enter aggregate totals per ballot option only; per-attendee vote lines are not created for this item.
Entered total votes do not match the expected reference total. Adjust the counters or expected total before finalizing.

group.div: Define the choices: each row is one option voters may pick. Use Choice for the label and reorder with the handle. Final totals are entered in the same table in the next section.
Enter final totals: use Votes for the total ballots counted for each choice. Only aggregate numbers are stored; the system does not record how each attendee voted.
Add at least one ballot option row before entering vote counts.

sheet.div: Sum of votes in the table does not match the expected reference total. Adjust the Votes column or expected total before finalizing.
When Expected total votes is set (non-zero), the sum of all Votes must match it; other validation still applies when it is zero.

page.name: attendees
page.div: Attendance: Listed — not finalized = on the list only (not quorum, not an active delegate). Attended (confirmed present) = counts for quorum and voting; delegations to this person can activate. Did not attend = absent (excluded from quorum). Use Record as attended / Record as absent on each row.

button.name: action_confirm
button.title: Set attendance to Attended (confirmed present): member actually attended; counts for quorum and voting.

button.name: action_mark_absent
button.title: Set attendance to Did not attend (absent): excluded from quorum; delegations to this person stay inactive until attended.

ul.li: Saving creates or updates the rule on the server; delete the row to revoke (stored vote lines refresh on the next rebuild or attendance change).
Delegator transfers units only for the vote types on the row (empty = all types on this assembly).
Transfer becomes Active only when the delegate is Attended (confirmed present); until then the row shows Waiting.
Inspect delegated out / delegated in on each attendee’s Votes by type.
